name: RHM-T1W
summary: RHM-T1W is CRP Robot’s second-generation wheeled humanoid, first publicly demonstrated in March 2026 and presented internationally at Hannover Messe in April 2026. It combines an autonomous mobile base with a human-shaped upper body, two arms and dexterous hands. CRP describes navigation, inspection, sorting and material-handling applications in industrial environments. Public sources establish a demonstrated product; general commercial availability has not been confirmed.
